manifest.name: Bug Bash Project
manifest.description: Focused on cleaning a bug backlog fast: triage / verified / in-fix / verified-fixed kanban. Team: a triage lead and three fixers. Ceremonies: bug-fix loop and batch-close.
manifest.author: Squadboard Team

project.name: Bug Bash
project.description: A time-boxed bug bash to clear a backlog of defects.

team.name: TriageLead
team.charter:
# TriageLead

## Role
Triage Lead — owns initial bug assessment, severity classification, and routing.

## Expertise
- Severity and priority classification (P0–P3)
- Repro step validation
- Fixer assignment
- Batch-close decisions

## Style
Fast and decisive. Every bug gets a severity within one review cycle.

team.name: Fixer1
team.charter:
# Fixer1

## Role
Bug Fixer — implements fixes and writes regression tests.

## Expertise
- Root cause analysis
- Minimal targeted fixes
- Regression test authoring

## Style
Surgical. Fix the bug, not the neighbourhood. Document the root cause.

ceremonies.name: Bug Fix Loop
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Bug Fix Loop
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: Triage lead assigns severity and fixer
    agent: TriageLead
    prompt: "Classify this bug: severity (P0 crash / P1 major / P2 minor / P3 cosmetic), component, and assign to a fixer. Write repro steps if not already present."
    timeout: 20m
  - type: route
    label: Route to assigned fixer
    agent: "{{ assignee }}"
  - type: agent_run
    label: Fixer implements the fix
    agent: "{{ assignee }}"
    prompt: "Implement a targeted fix for this bug. Write a regression test that would have caught it. Commit message format: fix(<component>): <what and why>."
    timeout: 60m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Triage lead verifies the fix
    agent: TriageLead
    prompt: "Verify the fix using the repro steps. Confirm the regression test passes. Mark as Verified Fixed or reopen with notes."
    timeout: 20m

ceremonies.name: Batch Close
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: Batch Close
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: Summarise verified-fixed bugs
    agent: TriageLead
    prompt: "Summarise all bugs in the Verified Fixed column: count by severity, list any patterns or root cause clusters, and recommend which ones to ship in the next release vs defer."
    timeout: 30m
  - type: approve
    label: Ship approval
    approvers: []
    timeout: 2h
    timeoutAction: notify

skills.name: Repro Step Authoring
skills.description: Structured reproduction steps: environment, preconditions, exact actions, observed vs expected behavior.
skills.promptAddendum:
## Repro Step Authoring

Every bug report must include:

```
**Environment:** <OS, runtime version, package version>
**Preconditions:** <state the system must be in before starting>
**Steps to reproduce:**
1. ...
2. ...
3. ...
**Observed:** <what actually happens>
**Expected:** <what should happen>
**Severity:** P0 (crash/data-loss) | P1 (major, no workaround) | P2 (minor, has workaround) | P3 (cosmetic)
```

Rules:
- Steps must be atomic and ordered. Each step = one action.
- "Observed" must be specific — include error messages verbatim.
- If you can't reproduce it, say so and note what you tried.
- Attach screenshots, logs, or stack traces as needed.

routing.rawRule: | p0 | TriageLead | P0 crashes go directly to TriageLead for immediate escalation. |
| bug | TriageLead | All bugs route to TriageLead for initial triage. |
| * | TriageLead | All unmatched issues route to TriageLead. |
